prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a parking lot collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1494; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Inspection of the rear bumper cover, left quarter panel and tail lamp assembly shows damage consistent with the reported low-speed contact in a parking lot, and the pattern of deformation lines up with the impact described. No prior damage to the vehicle is known from the file or from the inspection. The proposed repair plan is to replace the bumper cover, refinish the quarter panel and install a new tail lamp, and the labor hours listed fit the work required. Two similar charges entered on the same day are currently under review and will be confirmed before payment is released.
